headline: The Federal Reserve raised its target range by 25 basis points to 3.75 to 4.00 percent, the first hike since July 2023, and the Dow fell 631 points while the 10 year Treasury yield settled at 5.01 percent.

summary.us: The FOMC voted unanimously to lift the funds target to 3.75 to 4.00 percent and the new projections showed 16 of 18 officials penciling in another increase this year, which sent the Dow down 631 points or 1.21 percent and the S&P 500 down 0.45 percent to 7,551.81. Banks took the worst of it on the prospect of further tightening, with Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Bank of America and Citigroup each off more than 3 percent, while the Nasdaq Composite ended flat and the 10 year yield closed at 5.006 percent.
summary.india: The Nifty 50 rose 0.43 percent to 23,217.60 and the Sensex added 332.63 points to 74,336.45, snapping a two session fall ahead of the Fed, with FMCG, realty and banks leading and IT and pharma lower. Foreign investors sold 2,032.60 crore rupees of cash equities while domestic institutions bought 3,908.20 crore rupees, and the rupee held near record lows at 95.99 per dollar as Bank Nifty gained 0.89 percent to 56,292.
summary.global: Asia closed higher before the Fed, with the Nikkei 225 up 0.69 percent to 63,923 and the Hang Seng up 0.19 percent to 24,713.78, and Europe followed as the DAX added 0.53 percent and the FTSE 100 0.29 percent. Brent fell 2.8 percent to 105.71 dollars and WTI dropped 3.6 percent to 102.02 dollars after Saudi Arabia moved to restore about half the capacity of its East West pipeline, while the dollar index gained 0.65 percent to 100.30 and gold held at 4,346.90 dollars.

calendar.what: Bank of England rate decision with the Monetary Policy Summary and MPC minutes. The Bank of Japan two day meeting begins. US weekly jobless claims. The NSE and Sonaselection India IPOs open in India.

Bank of Japan statement on monetary policy, where about 89 percent of surveyed economists expect a 25 basis point move to 1.25 percent. Hero Motors, Jindal Supreme and SS Retail IPOs close. Reliance Industries is expected to take bids for its 12,500 crore rupee bond issue by the end of this week.
NSE and Sonaselection India IPOs close. Allotment expected for Hero Motors, Jindal Supreme and SS Retail.
Allotment expected for Sonaselection India. No major scheduled macro release was confirmed for this date in this run.
Tentative listing for Hero Motors and Jindal Supreme on the NSE and BSE. Meta Connect developer conference runs 23 and 24 September.
A-One Steels India IPO opens. Tentative listing for the NSE and Sonaselection India issues. The next RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting falls outside this window, on 5 to 7 October 2026.
